lines.speaker: Gopinath Sahu
lines.text: Arjun Nayak. Twelve years, and you walk back into this village like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Arjun Nayak
lines.text: Gopinath. I came as soon as I heard about my father.

lines.speaker: Gopinath Sahu
lines.text: Prakash is dead. There is a package here for you. He left it before... before it happened.

lines.speaker: Gopinath Sahu
lines.text: Take it. Look at it properly. Then you will understand why people here do not ask questions.

lines.speaker: Gopinath Sahu
lines.text: I mean this village remembers. And it does not forgive people who leave.
